continuity_scope: Soul Land, WebNovel English web-novel edition attributed to Tang Jia San Shao: Prologue and Chapter 1, "Soul Land, Otherworldly Tang San" parts 1-2 (catalog entries 1-3 / chapter page locators). This is a bounded opening-prose pass in that English edition only.

coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic character directly named in the selected Prologue/Chapter 1 Part 1-2 prose/metadata. Only Tang San is supported. Tang Sect, martial souls, Soul Masters, Martial Soul Hall, hidden weapons, techniques, ranks, sects, beasts, rings, items, and places remain terms or omissions.
omissions: All other characters, including family, teachers, allies, enemies, spirit beasts, later deities, and later identities, are outside this three-entry opening witness unless directly named and supported there.
Later chapters/volumes, original Chinese text, manhua, donghua, games, live action, other Soul Land installments, and adaptations are separate continuities/witnesses.
Specific martial souls, rings, ranks, skills, hidden weapons, locations, and detailed plot outcomes beyond the prose passages and catalog titles are not asserted.

Reincarnation/transmigration, a youth beginning training near age one, cliff/fall material, combat preparation, and potential violence/death are recorded only at the premise level; no psychological, injury, or graphic-content detail is extrapolated.
uncertainties: The selected English WebNovel witness gives Tang San's English romanization but does not supply Chinese script or confirm alternate English spellings; none is added.
WebNovel's synopsis uses broad series language while the bounded prose pages supply only a small early sample. Later claims, including rulership/godhood language in the synopsis, are excluded.
The site identifies the work as a completed 690-chapter web novel. That catalog/edition status does not make web-novel wording equivalent to manhua, donghua, games, or live-action adaptations.

Some chapter title numbering is platform-specific (the catalog lists a prologue as entry 1 and multiple split Chapter 1 entries); URLs and full page titles are retained as the precise witness locators.
evidence_basis: WebNovel official English series, catalog, and early chapter pages only; no fan wiki, Wikipedia, unofficial translation, adaptation recap, or illustration is used.
